result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation bar is obscured by a thick black bar overlaying the central icons.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar overlays the bottom navigation bar, partially obscuring the middle icons (search and saved/bookmarks). Only the Home icon on the left and Profile icon on the right are fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the overlaying bar element and ensure the bottom tab bar is fully visible above the system gesture area with proper padding and safe-area handling.
